querySettings.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    a.customer_id           AS custometid,
    a.name                  AS customername,
    CASE
        WHEN a.customer_id = 'CS0263' THEN
            'ASIA PACIFIC'
        ELSE
            b.cf$_region_description
    END                     AS region,
    a.country               AS countryname,
    a.cf$_customer_category AS customersegment
FROM
    ifsapp.customer_info_cfv a
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            identity,
            cf$_region_description
        FROM
            ifsapp.customer_order_inv_join_cfv
    )                 b ON a.customer_id = b.identity
WHERE
    a.customer_id IN ( 'CS0154', 'CS0174', 'CS0124', 'CS0179', 'CS0035',
                       'CS0153', 'CS0211', 'CS0026', 'CS0088', 'CS0160',
                       'CS0230', 'CS0239', 'GRI50', 'CS0121', 'CS0142',
                       'CS0039', 'CS0194', 'CS0203', 'CS0169', 'CS0009',
                       'CS0099', 'CS0073', 'CS0044', 'CS0091', 'CS0092',
                       'CS0030', 'CS0007', 'CS0093', 'CS0101', 'CS0045',
                       'CS0133', 'CS0135', 'CS0037', 'CS0156', 'CS0061',
                       'CS0173', 'CS0076', 'CS0195', 'CS0196', 'CS0199',
                       'CS0209', 'CS0213', 'CS0215', 'CS0226', 'CS0235',
                       'CS0237', 'CS0257', 'CS0263', 'CS0265','GRI51' ,'CS0014','CS0082','CS0021','CS0067','CS0068','CS0002','CS0116','CS0120','CS0040','CS0098','CS0132','CS0138','CS0130','CS0144','CS0069','CS0149','CS0152','CS0140','CS0157','CS0158','CS0178','CS0180','CS0187','CS0191','CS0163','CS0202','CS0206','CS0205','CS0216','CS0190','CS0225','CS0263'
)
    AND a.cf$_customer_category IS NOT NULL
    and  b.cf$_region_description is not null
